set.body:
Journey: See. Track: tools.

Outcome
The demo holds one study whose grid shows every data type the institute named.

Acceptance
1. A seeded study contains anatomical and functional MRI, EEG, MEG, eye-tracking recorded as BIDS physio with a recording-eye label, behaviour, and one phenotype table with a dictionary. Use public CC0 or PDDL sources: an excerpt of ds000117 for MRI, MEG, EEG and behaviour, and the eye-tracking example whose paths are already in the described-paths fixture. Anything synthetic is marked synthetic in the README.
2. It imports with no error findings. The grid shows MRI and tables as assessed, and EEG, MEG and eye-tracking as described.
3. It stays small enough for the one-command demo: under 300 MB. Images may be cropped or downsampled, and the README says so.
4. scripts/demo-instance.py seeds it.

Start from
- scripts/demo-instance.py: lab and dataset specifications near line 50.
- modules/app/src/test/resources/bids-examples/described-paths.txt.
- modules/app/src/test/resources/multimodal-conformance.

Evidence
scripts/check-demo-instance.sh passes. A screenshot of the grid.
set.title: SEE7: Seed one study with MRI, EEG, MEG, eye-tracking, behaviour and questionnaires
